title: God's Calling You Out: Stop Making Excuses
paragraphs: §Caught Up with Taking Care of Your Own Houses

Alright, so check it. This went down on the first day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius's reign. God's message came through the prophet Haggai, and it was for Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, the governor of Judah, and for Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
This is what God-of-the-Angel-Armies had to say: 'My people are procrastinating. They're all like, 'Nah, it's not the right time to rebuild God's Temple.''

So a little later, God had more to say, and Haggai laid it all out: 'Oh, so it's the 'right time' for you all to be living in your slick new houses while MY house, the Temple, is a complete wreck? Make it make sense.'

And then God-of-the-Angel-Armies came back with more: 'Yo, take a good, hard look at your lives. Seriously, think about it. You're dropping a ton of cash, but you have basically nothing to show for it. You keep loading up your plates, but you're never actually full. You keep drinking and drinking and drinking, but you're always thirsty. You're layering up clothes, but you can't get warm. And the people working for you? What are they getting? Pretty much nothing—like a leaky, busted bucket. That's what.'
That's why God-of-the-Angel-Armies said: 'Take a good, hard look at your life. Think it over.'

Then God was like: 'Here’s the plan: Go up to the hills, chop down some trees, and bring the timber back to rebuild the Temple. Do it for me. Show me some respect. You had all these big dreams for yourselves, but it all came to nothing. And the little you did bring to my Temple? I just blew it away—it was nothing.'

'And why?' (This is a message from God-of-the-Angel-Armies, just so you know.) 'It's because while you've all been running around, busy fixing up your own houses, my house is a total ruin. That's why. Because you've been stingy. So I've hit you with a dry summer and a pathetic harvest. I've matched your tight fists with a drought, drying up the fields and hills, making your gardens and orchards wither, and stunting your crops. Nothing—not you, not your animals, not your crops—is gonna thrive.'

Then Governor Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, High Priest Joshua son of Jehozadak, and all the people with them actually listened to the voice of their God. When God sent Haggai the prophet to them, they paid attention. By listening to Haggai, they were showing God respect.
Then Haggai, God's messenger, gave the people God's message: 'I am with you!' That's God's Word.

And that's how God got Zerubbabel, Joshua, and all the people fired up—and they started working on the Temple of God-of-the-Angel-Armies. This all happened on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.

title: God's Epic Temple Upgrade Is Coming
paragraphs: §This Temple Will End Up Better Than It Started Out

On the 21st day of the 7th month, a message from God came through the prophet Haggai. He was told to say this to Governor Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, High Priest Joshua son of Jehozadak, and all the people: "Is anyone still around who saw the first Temple in all its glory? And what do you see now? Kinda pathetic, right?
"'So, get to work, Zerubbabel!'—this is God talking.
"'Get to work, Joshua, son of Jehozadak—the high priest!'
"'Get to work, all you people!'—God is saying.

"'Yeah, get to work! Because I am with you.' The God of the Angel Armies is speaking! 'Live out the covenant I made with you when you left Egypt. I am literally living and breathing among you right now. Don't be scared. Don't hold back.'

"This is what the God of the Angel Armies said: 'In a little while, I'm going to shake up the sky and the earth, the ocean and the land. I'll shake up all the nations that don't know me. They'll bring tons of wealth, and I will fill this Temple with splendor.' The God of the Angel Armies says so.
"'I own all the silver, and I own all the gold.' A decree from the God of the Angel Armies.

"'This new Temple is going to be way better than the original. It had a glorious start, but the finish will be even more glorious. It will be a place where I give out wholeness and holiness.' A decree from the God of the Angel Armies.

On the 24th day of the 9th month (this was in the second year of King Darius's reign), God's message came to Haggai again: "The God of the Angel Armies says: 'Ask the priests for a ruling. If someone is carrying a piece of holy meat in their pocket, and that pocket touches some bread, stew, wine, oil, or any other food, does that food become holy too?'"
The priests answered, "No."
Then Haggai asked, "What if someone becomes unclean by touching a dead body, and then they touch one of these foods? Does the food become unclean?"
The priests said, "Yes, it will become unclean."
Then Haggai said, "'That's what this nation is like. Everything they do is unclean. Whatever they offer me is unclean.' God says so.

"'Think about it. Before you started laying the first foundation stones for my Temple again, how were things for you? Isn't it true that because you were dragging your feet and only giving a half-hearted effort to rebuild, your crops were also only giving you half of what you expected? I sent drought and disease and hail. Everything you tried to do got messed up. But it didn't even seem to bother you. You just kept ignoring me.' God's decree.

"'Now, think about what's going to happen starting today—this 24th day of the 9th month. From the day the Temple rebuilding started, has anything in your fields—your vines, fig trees, pomegranates, olive trees—failed to grow? From now on, you can expect a blessing.'"
God's message came to Haggai a second time on that same important day, the 24th day of the 9th month: "Speak to Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah:

"'I am about to shake everything up, turn it all upside down, and start over. I will overthrow governments, destroy foreign powers, and get rid of all weapons. I'll throw armies into chaos, and they'll end up fighting each other. And on that day'"—this is God's message—"'I will take you, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, my personal servant, and I will make you like a signet ring, a symbol of my authority. I've looked everywhere and I've chosen you for this job.'" The message from the God of the Angel Armies.
